title: Pure-section normalization of the chain tensor-Hom equivalence
statement: Let Y be a scheme in universe t and R a commutative ring sheaf in universe max(u,t+1) on its pro-etale site. For arbitrary unbounded complexes A,L,N of R-module sheaves, there is an equivalence between chain maps A tensor L to N and chain maps A to Hom(L,N). For every chain map psi and homogeneous local sections x of A in degree i and y of L in degree j, evaluation of the degree-i component of the image of psi on x at y equals the degree-(j+i) component of psi applied to the homogeneous tensor generator of x,y, with the canonical degree transport. The Hom complex, total tensor, evaluation and generator are those of [def-pur-hom-complex], [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves], [def-sf-integral-hom-reduction-models] and [def-coef-ringed-tensor-hom-model].

proof.text: Use the existing native chain tensor-Hom equivalence. Its inverse pure-section formula applies to the image of psi. The inverse-image identity gives the required equation; the internal-Hom sign and braiding sign cancel for the specified factor order.

proof_origin.place: paragraphs 1-2; coefficient, chain-map and normalization steps separated

theorem homComplexTensor_pure_equivalence
    (A L N : CochainComplex (Modules.{t, u} Y R) ℤ) :
    ∃ e : ((((totalTensor.{t, u} Y R).obj A).obj L) ⟶ N) ≃
        (A ⟶ homComplex.{t + 1, t, max u (t + 1), max u (t + 1)} (R := R) L N),
      ∀ (psi : (((totalTensor.{t, u} Y R).obj A).obj L) ⟶ N)
        (i j : ℤ) (U : (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.ProEt Y)ᵒᵖ)
        (x : (A.X i).val.obj U) (y : (L.X j).val.obj U),
        evaluate.{t, u} Y R L N i j U (((e psi).f i).val.app U x) y =
          (psi.f (j + i)).val.app U
            (coefficientTensorGenerator.{u, t + 1, t}
              (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.ProEt.topology Y) R
              A L i j (j + i) (add_comm i j) U x y)
